title: Robust Forest-based Estimation of Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Under High-dimensional Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.28662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how patients with Alzheimer's disease respond differently to treatment is important for individualized therapeutic assessment. Using observational data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), we investigate how the association between donepezil dosage and 12-month cognitive performance varies across diagnostic stages and hippocampal volumes. This analysis presents several statistical challenges, including potentially nonlinear treatment effect heterogeneity, high-dimensional confounding, and heavy-tailed outcomes with extreme observations. To address these challenges, we develop an Orthogonal Huber Random Forest (OHRF) framework that combines Huber-based robust estimation, Neyman orthogonality, and forest-based adaptive weighting. translated_title: 高维混淆因素下基于森林的异质性处理效应稳健估计
translated_abstract: 理解阿尔茨海默病患者对治疗的不同反应对于个性化治疗评估十分重要。利用阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）的观察性数据，我们研究了多奈哌齐剂量与12个月认知表现之间的关联如何随诊断阶段和海马体体积的变化而变化。该分析带来了若干统计挑战，包括潜在的非线性处理效应异质性、高维混淆因素，以及含有极端观测值的重尾结果。为了应对这些挑战，我们开发了一个正交Huber随机森林框架，该方法结合了基于Huber的稳健估计、Neyman正交性和基于森林的自适应加权。所提出的方法能够处理复杂的处理效应异质性，同时降低对干扰参数估计误差和极端结果的敏感性。我们建立了其一致性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出正交Huber随机森林（OHRF）框架，通过融合Huber稳健估计、Neyman正交性与森林自适应加权，在高维混淆、非线性异质性和重尾极端结果的阿尔茨海默病观察数据中稳健地估计异质性处理效应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Orthogonal Huber Random Forest (OHRF) framework that combines Huber-based robust estimation, Neyman orthogonality, and forest-based adaptive weighting to robustly estimate heterogeneous treatment effects under high-dimensional confounding, nonlinear heterogeneity, and heavy-tailed outcomes in Alzheimer's disease observational data.
